title: United-Inch Size Brackets for Window Replacement Contracts
content:
# United-Inch Size Brackets

A window opening on a Window Replacement Contracts contract is sized in united inches: the measured width plus the measured height, each rounded up to the next whole inch. Each Ridgeline series sets a standard bracket, a series maximum, and a surcharge per opening for openings between the two.

| Series | Standard bracket, up to (united inches) | Series maximum, up to (united inches) | Oversize surcharge per opening |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 101 | 120 | $89.00 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 101 | 120 | $96.00 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 101 | 130 | $104.00 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 110 | 130 | $128.00 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 110 | 140 | $146.00 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 120 | 144 | $172.00 |

## Bands for one opening

| Size of the opening | Band |
|---|---|
| At or below the standard bracket | Standard size |
| Above the standard bracket and at or below the series maximum | Oversize, carrying the series surcharge per opening |
| Above the series maximum | Cannot be built in that series |

## Hypothetical sizing

A hypothetical opening measuring 35.25 inches wide and 47.5 inches high rounds to 36 and 48 whole inches, giving 84 united inches (36 plus 48). In a series whose standard bracket reaches at least 84 united inches, that opening is standard size. The measurements are invented for illustration.
